text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping, I saw 
Curren Chan inviting Admire Vega to a 
cafe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is all tired out... Let's take a 
break with some sweets, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I'm heading home. ...Give me the 
luggage."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ayabe-san's trainer! We're just about 
to go eat pancakes together~

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't jump to conclusions. We just ran 
into each other by chance, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's mouth is totally in pancake mode 
now. Look, Trainer, you have that "now I'm 
craving pancakes too~" look on your face~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So let's all make pancakes together. 
Pancake, pancake♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hold on, don't pull so... Ah, jeez...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here it is~♪ A pancake tower!! The fruit 
decorations are so cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pancake tower stacked high with thick 
pancakes. The amount of fruit and guimauve 
served alongside it is quite substantial 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's dish it out and eat! Bon 
appétit~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, this is... so very fluffy...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! The pancakes here are so 
fluffy, they just melt in your mouth!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's so fluffy... Light on the palate, so 
it's easy to eat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pancakes on Admire Vega's plate are 
disappearing in the blink of an eye.
choice_data_list: (I'll just let her eat her fill.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pancakes on Admire Vega's plate are 
disappearing in the blink of an eye.
choice_data_list: (I'll just let her eat her fill.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ah... O-Of course, just this one plate, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ……So delicious……

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I just knew you'd love these fluffy 
pancakes, Ayabe-san~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega thoroughly savored a sensible 
portion of pancakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega has a stoic side to her. 
Wanting her to indulge in what she likes 
for once, I quietly watched over her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The bottom part has a texture like chiffon 
cake. This is so fluffy too...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just knew you'd love these fluffy 
pancakes, Ayabe-san~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Admire Vega devoured a tower of 
pancakes meant for several people almost 
entirely on her own.
